title: CAD Inspection AI Agent
description: DWG/DXF → vector → LLM/VLM agent that inspects drawings and reports findings.
subtitle: CAD Parser: an add-on for CADian 2026 that reads a DWG floor plan, works out what is in it, links doors and windows to the spaces they serve, checks the plan against inspection rules, and answers questions about it with evidence on the drawing.
